{{Quote|The Gungan Caves. Find the hidden places and unlock secret doors you must.|[[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] to a [[Unidentified young new recruit|promising Jedi youngling]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Yoda's Challenge Activity Center">''[[Star Wars: Yoda's Challenge Activity Center]]''</ref>}}
The '''Gungan Caves''' were a system of artificial caves on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], probably built by the [[Elders (Naboo)/Legends|Elders]]. The caves contained ancient [[Gold/Legends|golden]] [[Unidentified Gungan sacred statues|statues]]. Around [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], an [[Unidentified young new recruit|young, new recruit]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] was sent on Naboo to recover the statues.

==Description==
The Gungan Caves were a maze of underground tunnels, partially under [[Water/Legends|water]]. At the center of the caves system, a circular area featured four sealed doors leading to the sacred [[Unidentified Gungan sacred statues|statues]]. Each door was to be opened with the help of ten jewelled keys that had been scattered throughout the caves. Carving on the doors depicted animals from the wildlife of Naboo, namely a [[Shaak/Legends|shaak]], a [[Kaadu/Legends|kaadu]], a [[Opee sea killer/Legends|opee sea killer]] and a [[Peko-peko/Legends|peko-peko]].
